questions.question: Differentiate between observation skills and analytical skills, giving examples from community social work.
questions.solution_html:
• Differentiate between observation skills and analytical skills, giving examples from
  • community social work.
  •  Definition: Observation skills involve carefully watching and listening to
  • understand people and situations, while analytical skills involve interpreting the
  • information gathered to make informed decisions.
  •  Purpose: Observation helps identify visible behaviors or conditions (e.g., poor
  • sanitation), whereas analysis helps understand underlying causes (e.g., lack of
  • municipal services).
  •  Process: Observation is direct and sensory; analysis involves reasoning,
  • comparison, and critical thinking.
  •  Example: A social worker observes low attendance in a women’s meeting
  • (observation) and analyzes that cultural restrictions or timing issues are the causes
  • (analysis).
  •  Outcome: Together, they help in accurate problem assessment and effective
  • intervention planning in community work.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
questions.final_answer: Verified per official MGU Scheme of Valuation.
